observations.description: The auto-vpn-when-off-net option is set to disable when the FortiGate does not have a FortiClient 5.2 License
Interfaces configured with PPPoE can be added to Virtual WAN Links.
Zone interface or zone member can be SSL VPN Interfaces.
Normal CPU usage in cmdbsvr and httpsd after cache build-up.
Webfilter URL filter lists upgrade successfully.
The AirCard 340U modem is compatible with FortiOS v5.2.0.
Zone interfaces are available for Local-in policies.
FortiGate units may be unable to authorize dual link FortiSwitches.
Application control cloud-based signatures do not appear.
The application control signature categories File.Sharing and Special have been removed but may still visible on the GUI.

If you change a policy from proxy-based Web Filtering to flow-based Web Filtering, users who receive HTTPS traffic may see an invalid certificate error message in their web browser. This happens because of how proxy-based and flow-based HTTPS web filtering generates CA certificates.
Inspection mode for the default antivirus profile after upgrade will have different attributes than the default configuration.
Customized charts lost in default report layout after upgrade.

SSL VPN portals can be deleted even if they are added to the Authentication/Portal Mapping list on the SSL VPN settings page. If a portal selected in the portal mapping list on the SSL VPN settings page is deleted you cannot save SSL VPN settings.
Filter applied in any of the FortiView widgets also affects other FortiView widgets.
GUI will encounter Internal Server Error when modifying log setting page if FAZ is connect via IPSec.
The FortiGate fails to reserve an IP address for a client once added through the DHCP monitor.
Custom defined application signatures belonging to a certain category may fail to be detected.
Restoring a VDOM configuration through the GUI fails.
Create multiple custom categories consecutively may result in the second to fail.
The FGT-70D may fail to boot when changing from switch mode to interface mode.
The pyfcgid daemon may crash when browsing FortiView.
The traffic log shows utmaction=allow when spam is blocked.
The FortiGate fails to show login history in SSL-VPN web mode.
Client fails to receive firewall email authentication page if email-collection is enabled in the policy.
An installed FMC-XG2 card intermittently may block traffic
Downgrading from v5.2.0 to v5.0 and then upgrading to v5.2.0 again will fail unless you run the execute log downgrade-log command before downgrading to v5.0.
